title: Clockwork Horizon | ECHO//100 Episode 82
description: Kavi scales a vertical metropolis powered by his own lost memories. Episode 82 of ECHO//100: The Door War. This is an AI-assisted original fiction series.

scenes.text: The sky rips open, slamming Kavi against the side of a massive, ticking iron tower.
scenes.caption: Kavi pinned to tower
scenes.image_prompt: Vertical shot of Kavi in a red hoodie and glasses, pinned sideways to a giant bronze clock tower wall.

scenes.text: Byte detaches from Kavi’s backpack, floating toward a glowing, pulsing port in the brass machinery.
scenes.caption: Byte interfaces with port
scenes.image_prompt: Byte, a white floating robot with a cyan face and orange antenna, reaches toward a glowing gear.

scenes.text: As Byte connects, a surge of raw, erased memories floods the city’s complex, golden internal gears.
scenes.caption: Memories fueling the city
scenes.image_prompt: Golden clockwork gears spinning rapidly, illuminating holographic fragments of Kavi's past adventures.

scenes.text: Kavi gasps, recognizing the stolen seconds of his own life powering the city’s rhythmic, mechanical heartbeat.
scenes.caption: Kavi realizes the truth
scenes.image_prompt: Kavi looking at his hands, which are glowing with the same hue as the city's ticking gears.

scenes.text: Suddenly, Byte’s antenna locks into the central core, tethering his consciousness to the city’s mainframe forever.
scenes.caption: Byte permanently tethered
scenes.image_prompt: Byte locked into a central hub, orange antenna glowing bright as energy cables connect to his body.

scenes.text: Mira flickers into view, warning that these clocks are counting down to total, irreversible reality collapse.
scenes.caption: Mira reveals the countdown
scenes.image_prompt: Mira, a blue holographic figure in a teal coat, looking terrified as the clock hands reverse.

scenes.text: The ticking stops abruptly, replaced by a deafening silence that vibrates through the entire vertical world.
scenes.caption: The ticking stops
scenes.image_prompt: The giant clock tower frozen in time, with Kavi and Mira suspended against the vertical surface.

scenes.text: From every clock face, a voice identical to Kavi’s whispers a dark, synchronized threat at them.
scenes.caption: Kavi's voice echoes
scenes.image_prompt: A giant shadow looming over Kavi, with hundreds of clock faces showing Kavi's reflection in the glass.
